description: Ability to modify the target's DACL; typically used to grant oneself DCSync or GenericAll, then abuse.

telemetry.detail: DACL modification writes nTSecurityDescriptor - logged under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
Permissions on an object were changed - fires when SACL auditing covers the object.
A two-step pattern (grant rights, then use them) is a strong behavioural signal even without directory auditing.

abuse_primitive: Add an ACE granting DCSync or GenericAll to a controlled principal, then perform that follow-on abuse.
notes: Adds one directory-modification event on top of whatever the follow-on abuse costs. The chained abuse usually dominates the path score.
